title: B16 recovery boundary witnesses: concurrent triggers, interrupted ACK, owner/successor drift
outcome: Executable boundary witnesses establish that original-checkpoint result recovery uses one current owner, retains accepted receipt custody across local ACK interruption, and preserves successors and independent duties under owner drift.
acceptance: Concurrent triggers for the same retained original checkpoint produce at most one in-flight exact replay, preserve the immutable original request/report/key and exclusive receipt custody, and do not introduce Bind, Evaluate, Begin or provider redispatch.

After an authoritative Accepted checkpoint result is retained and its local durable ACK fails or is interrupted, a same-process accounting continuation completes without another wire checkpoint or host restart, preserving the exact canonical operation and any successor.

If current ownership, a successor or an independent duty changes while a replayed result is returned, the exact original Accepted result remains in canonical durable custody while no wrong head is consumed, no independent exclusion is released and no replacement provider delivery is sent.
